newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iranian exiles call for G7 sanctions on Iran.
newsitem.headline: Iranian exiles call for G7 sanctions on Iran.

text.p: An Iranian exile group based in Iraq on Saturday urged the current Group of Seven summit in Denver to impose sanctions on Iran.
Maryam Rajavi, elected by the Mujahideen Khalaq opposition organisation as Iran's president-in-exile, called on G7 leaders to "institute diplomatic and ecomomic sanctions against Tehran."
Rajavi told some 15,000 supporters in one of its bases that Iran's "clerical regime will be toppled before the end of the 20th century." Her speech was carried by satellite around the world.

The organisation uses Iraq as a base for attacks inside Iran. Their bases have been the target of Iranian air and rocket attacks and their office in Baghdad, now ringed with a concrete wall, has faced several mortar and bomb attacks.
